messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
may 27 Notes:


Today was a really unfortunate day to trade because we had the 10:00 short get absolutely edged and that would have been a really good winning trade, but we missed the level by about 2 points and I didn’t find another trade for the rest of the day.
,
In pre market it looked like price was starting to dump, and then when am session started we continued that dump and that made my bias bearish for the day because of the unfilled nwog that I thought we might fill. I waited for 10:00 to get an entry cause it was looking good, we made a cisd with the 10:00 candle and a 15m rb that rejected an fvg that aligned with 10:00. It also lined up with the ote, so I set my limit for 10:00 and then we unfortunately missed it by just a few points. (Screenshot 1)
,
The manipulation above 10:00 had a perfect top tick once price hit 00:00 and I was looking at it because I thought we would get that manipulation higher before going lower, but it was a little too risk-on for me so I didn’t take it. We didn’t get a good rejection block out of it either so I waited for 10:00 which is a way less risky setup. (Screenshot 2)
,
I looked for other trades during the day, but nothing materialized so I considered it a non trading day, which does such cause it is 1 of 2 full days I get on the charts. This happens though and it is better to just be patient then to force anything. My draw going into the rest of the week is probably going to be bearish and aim for the nwog unless we pump during overnight session back to all time highs losing all sight of it.
,

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias very apparent today to be bearish, though it did seem like a mmsm into reversal. as of this moment it still seem like it can play out. was going to find a play with 10 AM key open on either a long or short depending on how price reacts to it. sort of in between of bias because price did tap into 2 4H FVG and reject off of them. this led me to believe that we would resume bullish trend after this. on HTF it was also bullish. Stop pulled to bottom wick after first bullish candle to reduce risk, then BE after the nearest 1M swing high was broken over.
